summary: Admin portal E2E validation complete. Backend: 10/10 admin tests PASS in /app/backend/tests/test_admin_e2e.py including auth guards (401/403 without token, 403 for customer token), dashboard shape, orders list/filter, customers list, and the full customer -> admin -> customer status-update loop (Order Placed -> Confirmed -> Packed w/ tracking -> Delivered with payment_status=paid). Frontend at /admin: login (admin-email/password/login-submit) -> dashboard (stat cards Revenue ₹2,701, Orders 5, Customers 9, AOV ₹675, nav-orders, nav-customers, logout) -> orders list (filter chips All/Order Placed/Confirmed/Packed..., NEW badge on Order Placed, admin-order-<num> cards) -> order detail (admin-status-* chips, admin-tracking-input+save, admin-cancel, admin-refund) -> logout returns to /admin login. Customer reflection loop VERIFIED via API — after admin PUT status, GET /api/orders/{id} shows updated status, status_history grows, and tracking_number is set.

issues: Console deprecation warnings on web: 'shadow*' style props (use boxShadow) and props.pointerEvents (use style.pointerEvents). Non-blocking on native, but noisy on web preview.
useNativeDriver warning on web preview — falls back to JS animation (expected on web, not a bug).

action_items: Optional: migrate deprecated web style props ('shadow*' -> boxShadow, props.pointerEvents -> style.pointerEvents) to silence console warnings on the /admin web build.

Optional: on the admin order detail page, the 'Advance to next status' button correctly hides when status is Delivered (terminal). Consider also hiding the terminal Cancel/Refund buttons once status is Delivered to prevent regressive updates via UI (backend allows any status transition today).
critical_code_review_comments: backend/routers/admin.py: PUT /admin/orders/{id}/status appends status_history and sets payment_status=paid on Delivered as required. Uses $push correctly.
backend/routers/orders.py: GET /orders/{id} returns status_flow constant list matching admin flow — customer timeline is consistent.
frontend/app/admin/index.tsx: correctly routes to /admin/dashboard when token exists and after successful login (router.replace). KeyboardAvoidingView + ScrollView present.
frontend/app/admin/order/[id].tsx: 'Advance to next' calculates nextStatus from FLOW index. Terminal states (Cancelled/Refunded) correctly hide the advance button.
frontend/src/context/AdminContext.tsx: uses independent storage key 'sunsu_admin_token' so admin session does not collide with customer session (as designed).

success_rate.frontend: 100% (7/7 admin UI steps passed on mobile viewport 390x844)

seed_data_creation: Created 1 ephemeral customer (phone 9<epoch>), 1 address, 1 COD order (test data prefixed 'TEST Admin E2E') advanced through Order Placed -> Confirmed -> Packed (tracking TRACK123XYZ) -> Delivered. Order remains in DB (SUN30282175 observed in UI as Delivered).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Admin base at /admin, login testIDs: admin-email, admin-password, admin-login-submit. Dashboard: admin-nav-orders, admin-nav-customers, admin-logout. Orders list: admin-filter-<Name>, admin-order-<order_number>. Order detail: admin-advance-status, admin-status-<Status>, admin-tracking-input, admin-tracking-save, admin-cancel, admin-refund. Admin token is stored under localStorage key 'sunsu_admin_token' (independent of customer session). Env var used by tests: EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL. Backend E2E loop test lives at /app/backend/tests/test_admin_e2e.py::TestFullE2ELoop::test_full_status_update_loop and asserts customer GET /api/orders/{id} reflects admin-driven status + tracking_number changes.
rca_of_issue: N/A — no bugs found. All E2E flows working: (a) customer OTP login+COD checkout, (b) admin login + JWT-guarded endpoints, (c) admin advances status + attaches tracking, (d) customer GET /api/orders/{id} reflects new status/history/tracking_number, (e) Delivered flips payment_status to paid, (f) admin web UI renders correctly on mobile viewport 390x844 with all documented testIDs present.
